page: Microsoft Azure HB368-144rs_v5 is a high-performance compute instance from the HBv5 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 144 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture with an Intel processor. The system is equipped with 448.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.11 GB of RAM per core.

This server type includes 15,851 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable. It is also RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) capable, which supports low-latency, high-throughput networking across nodes. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the HB368-144rs_v5 offers high resource density, combining massive local NVMe storage with a high count of dedicated compute cores. This hardware profile is designed for high-performance computing (HPC) workloads, large-scale simulations, clustered database applications, and data-intensive processing tasks requiring fast local storage and low-latency node-to-node communication.
